title: F. Build XOR on a Segment
statement:
You are given an array of n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n, where all numbers are from 1 to 2^12 - 1.

You have to process q queries. Each query is defined by three integers l_i, r_i, x_i: you need to find the smallest set S = {s_1, s_2, …, s_k} that satisfies the following conditions:

The first line contains one integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 10^4).

The second line contains n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 2^12 - 1).

The third line contains one integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 10^6).

Then q lines follow. The i-th of them contains three integers l_i, r_i, x_i (1 ≤ l_i ≤ r_i ≤ n; 1 ≤ x_i ≤ 2^12 - 1).

For each query, print one integer — the minimum size of the required set. If such a set does not exist, print 0.

Consider the queries from the example:

Input:
```
73 5 4 1 7 3 151 3 11 4 11 3 24 7 51 7 8
```

Output:
```
2 1 3 3 0 
```
